title: Pure The Weather
summary: Pure The Weather control strategy built around Level 3 Fairy painters that paint Continuous Canvas Spells and Traps across the backrow. By banishing themselves as Quick Effects to activate the powers granted by adjacent Canvases, the painters dodge removal, disrupt the opponent, and seamlessly return to the field during each Standby Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Weather Painter Snow places 1 The Weather Continuous Spell or Trap directly from your Deck face-up in your Spell and Trap Zone on Normal Summon.

The Weather Forecast Field Spell places 1 The Weather Spell or Trap from your Deck face-up on the field, grants an additional Normal Summon of a The Weather monster, and allows face-up The Weather cards in your backrow to be used as Link Material for The Weather Link Monsters.
The Weather Painter Thunder sends 1 face-up Continuous Spell or Trap you control to the GY to place 1 The Weather Spell or Trap directly from your Deck face-up on the field.
The Weather Painter Cloud places up to 2 The Weather Spells or Traps from your GY face-up on the field whenever another face-up The Weather card you control is sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: The Weather Forecast + The Weather Painter Snow
steps: Activate The Weather Forecast, using its effect to place The Weather Snowy Canvas from your Deck face-up in your backrow.
Normal Summon The Weather Painter Snow via Forecast's additional Normal Summon, and activate its effect to place The Weather Rainbowed Canvas from your Deck face-up.
Normal Summon The Weather Painter Thunder as your standard Normal Summon.
Link Summon The Weather Painter Moonbow or The Weather Painter Rainbow using your monsters and face-up Canvases as Link Material via The Weather Forecast.
Activate Snowy Canvas's granted Quick Effect, banishing a Painter to search The Weather Thundery Canvas or The Weather Painter Sun.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: The Weather Painter Rainbow negates the Special Summon of an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect by sending itself to the GY and destroys it, and banishes a The Weather Painter it points to to negate any card or effect activation.

The Weather Painter Moonbow banishes an opponent's monster until the next turn's Standby Phase when Link Summoned, and Special Summons The Weather Painter Rainbow directly from your Extra Deck if destroyed.
The Weather Thundery Canvas bounces any opponent's monster that battles a The Weather monster to the hand at the start of the Damage Step without targeting or destroying.
The Weather Rainbowed Canvas Special Summons a The Weather monster with a different name from your Deck by banishing a Painter when the opponent controls a monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: The Weather Snowy Canvas banishes a Painter in its column or adjacent columns as a Quick Effect to add 1 The Weather card from your Deck to your hand.
The Weather Rainy Canvas banishes a Painter as a Quick Effect to return 1 Spell or Trap your opponent controls to the hand.
The Weather Cloudy Canvas banishes a Painter as a Quick Effect to halve the ATK of 1 face-up monster on the field while allowing it to attack directly.
The Weather Auroral Canvas banishes a Painter as a Quick Effect to banish 1 card added to the opponent's hand and make them draw 1 card.
